legend: You are developing the scheduling module for the new operating system. This module takes n%%ZSMJ0%% tasks to be executed and the dependencies between them and then puts them in a certain order for execution.

More formally, there are n%%ZSMJ1%% tasks numbered from 1%%ZSMJ2%% to n%%ZSMJ3%%. You are also given m%%ZSMJ4%% dependencies numbered from 1%%ZSMJ5%% to m%%ZSMJ6%%; i%%ZSMJ7%%-th of them is described by two numbers — ai%%ZSMJ8%% and bi%%ZSMJ9%%, meaning that the task ai%%ZSMJ10%% should be executed before the task bi%%ZSMJ11%%.

In some cases, there are cyclical dependencies — situations when according to the dependencies given some task t1%%ZSMJ12%% should be executed before t2%%ZSMJ13%%, t2%%ZSMJ14%% before t3%%ZSMJ15%%, ..., and tk−1%%ZSMJ16%% before tk%%ZSMJ17%% and tk%%ZSMJ18%% before t1%%ZSMJ19%%. Cyclical dependencies create a problem for scheduling, so you decided to remove some of the given dependencies in such a way that the resulting set does not contain any cyclical ones.
However, you still need to keep at least m/2%%ZSMJ20%% original dependencies to preserve some of the original information. You are to write the program performing this task.
input: One line containing the numbers n%%ZSMJ21%% and m%%ZSMJ22%% (2≤n≤105%%ZSMJ23%%, 1≤m≤3⋅105%%ZSMJ24%%).

m%%ZSMJ25%% further lines, each containing two numbers ai%%ZSMJ26%% and bi%%ZSMJ27%% (1≤ai,bi≤n%%ZSMJ28%%, ai≠bi%%ZSMJ29%%), describing the corresponding dependency between two tasks ai%%ZSMJ30%% and bi%%ZSMJ31%%.
output: The first line should should contain YES in case the desired subset of dependencies exists, and NO otherwise.

In the YES case second line should contain the number k%%ZSMJ32%% of the selected dependencies (please note that k%%ZSMJ33%% should be at least m/2%%ZSMJ34%%) and the third line should contain k%%ZSMJ35%% numbers — the ids of the selected dependencies. They are numbered from 1%%ZSMJ36%% to m%%ZSMJ37%% in the order given in the input.
